title: Microsoft Fabric Resource Saturation
dataSources: Fabric capacity metrics (`fabric:capacity:metrics`) and admin API.
app: Microsoft Fabric Capacity Metrics app exports and the Fabric Admin API via HEC scripted inputs.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=fabric:capacity:metrics
| stats max(cpu_pct) as max_cpu, avg(cpu_pct) as avg_cpu, max(memory_pct) as max_mem by host
| where max_cpu>85 OR max_mem>85
| sort - max_cpu
description: Tracks CPU and memory utilisation on Microsoft Fabric nodes and flags hosts running hot, which throttle every workload on the node and precede hard failures.
value: A saturated Microsoft Fabric node degrades all its users at once; catching saturation early drives autoscaling or workload rebalancing before an outage.
implementation: Ingest Microsoft Fabric host metrics; schedule every 10 minutes and alert when a node sustains high CPU or memory.
visualization: Table of host by peak resource use, heat map.
grandmaExplanation: We watch how hard the Microsoft Fabric servers are working so more power can be added before they slow down or crash.
